caption: The drawing features two views of a tall, rectangular grandfather clock: a side view on the left and a front view on the right. The clock is predominantly brown, resembling wood, with gold accents used for decorative elements such as finials, hinges, and keyholes. The front view displays a broken-arch pediment with three gold finials on top, a central arched opening where the clock face would be, and below it a long door featuring an oval glass insert and two gold decorative handles. The door sits above a larger, rectangular base with another oval glass insert in the center. The feet of the clock are bracket-shaped with slight curves. The side view shows the same bracket feet at the base, a simple rectangular body, and a protruding top section. The drawing is signed "Geoffrey Holit" at the bottom right. The background is plain and off-white.
title: Grandfather's Clock
